events.name: Bash
events.head: Check origin, sim stack scripts, test-run code
events.input: $ git fetch -q origin && git log --oneline -3 origin/main && git log --oneline 93ad569..origin/main -- cloud | head; grep -rln "8794" cloud/scripts app/scripts workshop-plan/ops 2>/dev/null | head; grep -n "test-run\|testRun" cloud/src/jobs-day2.ts | head -20; lsof -ti:8790,8794 | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read sim stack scripts
events.input: $ sed -n 1,60p cloud/scripts/run-dev.sh; echo ----; sed -n 1,40p cloud/scripts/run-funnel-preview.sh; echo ----; git diff --stat app/scripts/run-chain.sh; grep -n "8790\|8794\|sim\|test-run\|test_run" app/scripts/run-chain.sh | head -40

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read testRun implementation
events.input: $ sed -n 626,820p cloud/src/jobs-day2.ts

events.name: Bash
events.head: Locate width/utm/MCP code in testRun
events.input: $ grep -n "width\|375\|utm_source\|channel\|mcp\|MCP\|Browser Rendering\|skipped" cloud/src/jobs-day2.ts | sed -n 1,80p | awk -F: '$1>620'

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check local stack and probes calling test-run
events.input: $ for p in 8790 8791 8792 8794; do printf "$p: "; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" -m 3 http://127.0.0.1:$p/; done; grep -rln "test-run" app/scripts cloud/scripts --include=*.mjs | head; grep -rn "test-run" app/scripts/*.mjs cloud/scripts/*.mjs | grep -i "fetch\|post\|run(" | head -8

events.text: The stack is up. Let me see how probe-email-stripe sets up an attendee and builds the funnel.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read probe setup flow
events.input: $ sed -n 1,80p app/scripts/probe-email-stripe.mjs; echo ....; sed -n 255,300p app/scripts/probe-email-stripe.mjs

events.name: Bash
events.head: Grep probe setup calls
events.input: $ grep -n "api(\|const api\|preview\|admin\|enter\|connect\|sim_\|newContext\|goto" app/scripts/probe-email-stripe.mjs | head -60

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read probe setup body
events.input: $ sed -n 50,140p app/scripts/probe-email-stripe.mjs | cut -c1-260; echo ....; sed -n 264,286p app/scripts/probe-email-stripe.mjs | cut -c1-260

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find admin attendee routes and local admin token
events.input: $ grep -rn "preview/reset\|\"/admin/api/attendees\"\|admin/api/attendees/:id\|test: *1\|enter_url\|enterLink" cloud/src/*.ts | cut -c1-220 | head -20; ls ~/.config/tantra/ | head; grep -rln "admin-enter\|ADMIN_TOKEN\|local admin" cloud/scripts/*.sh app/scripts/*.sh 2>/dev/null | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find admin routes and chain's admin link
events.input: $ grep -rn "preview/reset" cloud/src | cut -c1-200 | head -5; grep -rln "attendees" cloud/src | head; sed -n 1,50p app/scripts/run-chain.sh | grep -n "enter\|ADMIN\|token"

events.name: Bash
events.head: Locate preview reset route
events.input: $ test -f /tmp/rc-local-admin-url && echo has-admin-url; grep -rn "preview\b\|/preview" cloud/src/index.ts cloud/src/admin*.ts 2>/dev/null | grep -i "reset\|route\|post" | cut -c1-200 | head -8; ls cloud/src | head -60 | tr '\n' ' '

events.text: Setting up the local simulator test-run for T-265: finding how to sign in to the local centre's admin.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read centre_admin helper and preview routes
events.input: $ sed -n 1,40p workshop-plan/tasks/centre_admin.py | cut -c1-200; grep -n "preview" cloud/src/index.ts | cut -c1-180 | head -12

events.name: Bash
events.head: List local attendees, find admin create route
events.input: $ CENTRE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8790 python3 workshop-plan/tasks/centre_admin.py GET /admin/api/attendees 2>&1 | python3 -c "

events.name: Bash
events.head: See raw local admin reply
events.input: $ CENTRE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8790 python3 workshop-plan/tasks/centre_admin.py GET /admin/api/attendees 2>&1 | head -c 400; echo; grep -n "admin/enter" cloud/src/index.ts | head -3

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read admin enter handler, who writes admin url
events.input: $ sed -n 1064,1080p cloud/src/index.ts | cut -c1-220; grep -rn "rc-local-admin-url" --include=*.sh --include=*.mjs --include=*.py -l . 2>/dev/null | grep -v node_modules | head -5

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find private-stack launcher scripts
events.input: $ grep -rln "SIM_PORT\|ADMIN_KEY:" cloud/scripts app/scripts workshop-plan/ops 2>/dev/null | grep -v dryrun | head;

events.name: Bash
events.head: See how a probe spins private stack
events.input: $ grep -n "SIM_PORT\|ADMIN_KEY\|wrangler\|persist\|8[0-9][0-9][0-9]" cloud/scripts/probe-stripe-refunds.mjs | head -20

events.text: Spinning up a private local stack (own sim, centre and funnel preview) so I can sign in as admin with a throwaway key.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find scripts that start a private centre
events.input: $ grep -rln "migrations\", \"apply\"\|migrations apply" cloud/scripts app/scripts 2>/dev/null | head -5

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read private-stack setup in probe-t268
events.input: $ sed -n 1,80p cloud/scripts/probe-t268.mjs | cut -c1-240 | grep -v "^\s*//" | head -60

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find attendee create and enter routes
events.input: $ grep -n 'res === "attendees"' cloud/src/index.ts | head; grep -n 'path === "/enter"\|"/e/"\|startsWith("/e/' cloud/src/index.ts | head -5

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read attendee create and enter handlers
events.input: $ sed -n 586,640p cloud/src/index.ts | cut -c1-200 | grep -n "POST\|test\|name\|email\|link\|token\|return" | head -25; sed -n 1051,1063p cloud/src/index.ts | cut -c1-200

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read private-stack spawn code
events.input: $ sed -n 18,75p cloud/scripts/probe-stripe-refunds.mjs | cut -c1-260

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read probe setup flow
events.input: $ sed -n 1,140p app/scripts/probe-email-stripe.mjs | cut -c1-300

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read probe flow body
events.input: $ sed -n 36,140p app/scripts/probe-email-stripe.mjs | cut -c1-400; echo ----; sed -n 255,290p app/scripts/probe-email-stripe.mjs | cut -c1-300

events.text: Building a private local stack driver for the T-265 test-run now.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find test-run usage and results code
events.input: $ grep -n "d3-\|test-run\|testRun" app/scripts/probe-email-stripe.mjs | cut -c1-250 | head -20; sed -n 840,910p cloud/src/jobs-day2.ts | cut -c1-260

events.name: Bash
events.head: List card sequence in probe
events.input: $ grep -no 'fill("[a-z0-9-]*"\|approve", { card_id: "[a-z0-9-]*"\|job("[a-z-]*"\|connect("[a-z0-9-]*"\|done("[a-z0-9-]*"' app/scripts/probe-email-stripe.mjs | sed -n 1,80p | tr '\n' ' '; echo; sed -n 260,285p app/scripts/probe-email-stripe.mjs | cut -c1-250

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find which jobs build channels
events.input: $ grep -rn '"tantra_email_campaign"\|"social"\b\|"blog_gate"\|"calendar_campaign"' cloud/src/*.ts | grep -i setState | cut -c1-200 | head; grep -rn "d3-outreach\|d3-email\|\"d3-[a-z-]*\"" cloud/src/jobs*.ts | grep -o '"d3-[a-z-]*"' | sort | uniq -c | head -20
